Group rides in Gurnee, IL

6 recurring group rides around Gurnee, IL: 4 road, 3 social, 1 gravel. 2 roll on weeknights, 3 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Bicycle Club of Lake County Tuesday Night Social Ride in Lake Bluff — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Velo Club Roubaix Saturday Ride runs a group 20-21 mph; B group 17-18.5 mph.
